data.spec: Final feedback owner adds self-contained OfficeFeedback frontend panel (minimal App.tsx mount only; preserve Jørg UI review) and additive GET /api/feedback -> {events:[{id,request_id:string|null,station_id,kind:'input'|'approval'|'ordered'|'maintenance'|'resolved'|'failed'|'alert'|'recovered'|'clarification',title,detail,created_at,severity:'routine'|'urgent'|'critical',simulation:boolean,whatsapp:{status:'disabled'|'pending'|'sent'|'failed'|'uncertain'|'skipped',detail:string}}],channels:{whatsapp:{configured:boolean,enabled:boolean,detail:string},board:{status:'unverified',detail:string}}}. Events newest first, durable IDs; new significant request/incident transitions only, no historical outbound replay. Browser enables opt-in speech/chime and opens exact request using ?request=<id>. WhatsApp disabled without explicit env opt-in and credentials; only link to authoritative dashboard, never approve via message. Hardware owner: please map status chimes to acknowledged speaker_play_rtttl action and publish bridge support; do not assume office_feedback supports sound.
